reading: Q1's M-056 holds WC-C-079 with Salla's SA-C-101, landed here, and Shopify's SH-C-139, landed in CM-SFR-011, this capability's parent. Strained (S1): its routes are the same statements as other concerns' own APIs, cited in other trees: /products and its attributes, categories, brands and tags in domain B's CM-CAT-001 to CM-CAT-006, /shopper-lists in D's CM-LOY-005, the cart coupon routes in D's CM-MKT-002, /products/reviews in D's CM-SUP-001. This cell cites the API as a whole and the routes no other concern holds. A reading.

A join on role, a reading: WooCommerce's Marketplace category Extensions > Store content and customizations (WC-S-0703), with its subcategories Store page enhancements (WC-S-0744) and Product images and media (WC-S-0742), is the place where third parties' additions to the storefront beyond the theme sit, the role of Shopify's App Store category Store design apps (SH-S-2662) and Salla's Component Bundle (SA-S-1165). Strained (S1): its subcategory Search and navigation (WC-S-0743) is cited in CM-SFR-013, another tree; Product images and media (WC-S-0742) is also cited in domain B's CM-CAT-007; its subcategory Cart and checkout features (WC-S-0740) and the Checkout Field Editor statements (WC-S-5484, WC-S-5486, WC-S-5487, WC-S-5488) are about checkout, domain C's subject, and no capability of E holds them (notes). No WooCommerce statement held defines the category.

Q1's M-014 holds WC-C-111 with Shopify's SH-C-029 and Salla's SA-C-090, both landed here: WooCommerce's onboarding task Choose your theme (WC-S-0418) and its admin API resources themes and onboarding/themes (WC-S-0194, WC-S-0200). Its other statements sit under this capability's children: Customize your store (WC-S-0419) in CM-SFR-002, the Marketplace category Themes (WC-S-0695) in CM-SFR-003, the patterns route (WC-S-0178) in CM-SFR-005. A reading: WordPress, not WooCommerce, provides themes and the editor that changes them; WooCommerce's statements show its own task list and API around them.

Q1's M-057 holds WC-C-089 with Shopify's SH-C-142 and Salla's SA-C-095, both landed here. WooCommerce's settings tab Point of Sale (WC-S-0010), its feature point_of_sale, "Enable Point of Sale functionality in the WooCommerce mobile apps" (WC-S-0937), and the POS mode of the mobile app that "turns a supported tablet or phone into a digital cash register" (WC-S-0892) are its own point of sale. Strained: its POS order emails (WC-S-0308, WC-S-0309), cited here as shows, are cited as core in domain D's CM-NTF-001 under WC-C-076, another tree. Its Marketplace category Official payments > In-person payments (WC-S-0711) is cited in CM-POS-002, this capability's child. A reading.

A join on role, a reading: WooCommerce's Selling location(s), which "lets you limit which countries you are willing to sell to" (WC-S-5354, WC-S-0600), sets where the store sells by country, the part of Shopify's markets that controls product availability by location (SH-S-0541) and of Salla's markets, versions of the store for each country, region or city it targets (SA-S-0157). Strained: WooCommerce's is one store-wide list of countries, and no statement held shows a version of the store per country (its currency, language or domain), which is what both anchors' markets are; its Shipping location(s) (WC-S-5355) is about shipping, domain C's subject (WC-C-030 names C under also), cited here as shows; its general settings page (WC-S-0880) is cited also in CM-MKS-005, another tree, for the currency it selects. The reviewer may split selling countries from markets.

Q1's M-087 holds WC-C-046 with Shopify's SH-C-111, landed here: both are visitor geolocation. WooCommerce's core plugin geolocates customers through MaxMind GeoLite2 data (WC-S-0640, WC-S-0641), set by Default customer location (WC-S-0602, WC-S-5377). Strained: WooCommerce's stated purpose is "to display tax rates and shipping methods specific to their location" (WC-S-0641); no statement held shows it sending buyers to a market's domain, country or currency, which is the capability's other half, and WooCommerce holds nothing on local domains. A reading.

Q1's M-044 pairs WC-C-051 with Shopify's SH-C-109, landed here, on currency conversion: WooPayments charges a currency conversion fee when a payment's currency differs from the merchant's bank accounts' (WC-S-0540) and converts it into the default currency (WC-S-0535, WC-S-0539). Strained: the concern's other half is payout currencies, which bank account and currency the payouts go to (WC-S-0536, WC-S-5314), domain C's payouts, where Shopify's Supported payout currencies sits (SH-C-069, domain C); this capability doesn't cite those two. Proposal: add C to WC-C-051's also. A reading.

Q1's M-044 pairs WC-C-052 with Shopify's SH-C-107, landed here, the store currency: "Each WooCommerce store can set one base currency. WooCommerce uses it to display product prices and record new orders" (WC-S-0876), the setting woocommerce_currency under General (WC-S-0598, WC-S-0001), as Shopify's store currency "used within your Shopify admin for pricing products and running reports" (SH-S-0361).

Q1's M-044 pairs WC-C-053 with Shopify's SH-C-108 and Salla's SA-C-163, both landed here: selling in more than one currency. "If you'd like to display products in different currencies (or allow customers to pay in a currency that differs from your shop's base currency), you will need to add a multi-currency extension/plugin" (WC-S-0875); WooPayments' built-in multi-currency is one (WC-S-0541). Its exchange rate statements (WC-S-0543, WC-S-0544) are cited in CM-MKS-007, this capability's child.

Q1's M-082 pairs WC-C-099 with Salla's SA-C-166, landed here: reference data of countries, by the term countries and the identifiers data/countries and Countries. WooCommerce's i18n/countries.php "Returns an array of countries and codes" (WC-S-5459), served by the REST routes data, data-countries and data-continents (WC-S-0124, WC-S-0126, WC-S-0125). Salla's also holds cities and districts, WooCommerce's continents (Q1's granularity note); the grain differs, not the thing.

Strained: WooCommerce's own grouping puts the category under Extensions > Store content and customizations (its identifier), the category WC-C-107 lands in CM-SFR-005, another tree; no statement held defines it, so whether it also holds currency or translation extensions (CM-MKS-006, CM-MKS-008, where Shopify's Currency and translation apps sit) isn't stated, and neither cell cites it. The word localization names an extension category here and core features on Shopify (Localizations, SH-C-032): notes, homonyms.
